verdict.rationale: Orrick offers self-service web tools (Tech Studio forms, document generators) and client portals, so a programmatic API is a fair thing to ask about. However, the evidence pack contains no mention of any API, API versioning, or deprecation policy, and the llms.txt probe returned 404. Absence of evidence for an applicable capability yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can rely on versioned APIs with a documented deprecation policy
